_doc: INDICATIVE grade-based norms for a sport-redpoint level. Evidence: coaching_practice — rough heuristics compiled from public coaching material, NOT validated norms. Individual variation is large (body mass, style, technique). Used only as one input (50 %) to the weakness ranking, together with the questionnaire and log trends.
caveat: Norms are indicative only. Many climbers redpoint well above or below these numbers. Use them to spot relative gaps, not as targets to chase.

transfer._doc: Expected gap (sub-grades) between board grade and outdoor boulder grade. A larger gap suggests a technique / style-transfer weakness to confirm.

criticalForce._doc: Giles et al. 2019: mean CF ~41 % of MVC in their climber sample.
